explanation: This fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial reached S2 and was unrewarded (in effect "S2 is bad, go to S1"): it is about 10 if S2 was reached rarely after choosing a1, and about 2-7 if it was reached commonly after choosing a2, rising with each consecutive unrewarded S2 trial (roughly 2, then 4, then 7). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after any rewarded trial, and at D1 after an unrewarded trial that ended in S1.
